title: AUDIT-04 page inventory row
description: One object per page.tsx file. pages.json is an ARRAY of these. Canonical source: 01-RESEARCH.md Architecture Patterns, Pattern 2 — pages have TWO auth rings, so middleware_protected alone is not the answer; layout_guard resolves the nearest guarded ancestor layout.tsx (src/app/admin/layout.tsx and src/app/moderation/layout.tsx both guard server-side while appearing in no middleware list).

component_type.description: client when the file carries the use-client directive, server otherwise.

data_source.description: Where the page gets its data: an internal API route, a direct Supabase query, a store, or none.

middleware_protected.description: Computed from the PROTECTED_ROUTES array read out of src/middleware.ts source — never from CLAUDE.md, which is stale.

layout_guard.description: Path of the nearest ancestor layout.tsx performing getUser() plus a role check, or null.

page_guard.description: In-page guard mechanism, or null when the page performs no guard of its own.

effective_protection.description: Human verdict combining both auth rings.

render_mode.description: Read from inventory/build-routes.txt (circle = static, f = dynamic). Never inferred from source.
